apps.name: AthleteOS Recorder
apps.localizedDescription: Raw Polar H10 overnight recorder. AthleteOS performs all analysis and coaching.

versions.localizedDescription: Targets Polar H10 PFTP 106 by forcing and verifying single-BLE-connection mode before Start night and before retained RR fetch, then reasserting single mode after any 106 reconnect. Keeps the H10 sensor copy until AthleteOS verifies upload.
